coordinate_system.origin: placement datum at floor Z=0, centred on the primary assembly; use listed bounds for asymmetric footprints

placement.allowed: green spawn-sketch areas that also satisfy keepouts
placement.caution: yellow requires map review for sightlines and route clearance

specimen-tank.title: Specimen tank
specimen-tank.assembly_note: One broad chamber, two soft collars and a chunky service return.
specimen-tank.detail: Glass is a closed proxy here. The dashed specimen contour locates the separate goo mesh.

specimen-pods.title: Specimen pods
specimen-pods.assembly_note: Two chamber sizes on one shared plinth. Reuse the tank chamber and collar profiles.
specimen-pods.detail: Each pod has its own glass and white goo masks.

lab-bench.title: Lab bench
lab-bench.assembly_note: Soft cabinet body and broad work tray. The drawer inserts can share the front face atlas.

goo-conveyor.title: Goo conveyor
goo-conveyor.assembly_note: A short belt with three repeatable goo blobs. The belt and legs can be one static assembly.

robot-arm.title: Robot arm
robot-arm.assembly_note: Two thick links and a two-jaw tool. Keep the open jaw shape legible from above.

valve-manifold.title: Valve manifold
valve-manifold.assembly_note: Three capped outlets and a thick cross handle. Reuse the 0.40 m pipe flange profile.

pipe-kit.title: Pipe kit
pipe-kit.assembly_note: Four reusable modules with the same 0.50 m barrel and 0.72 m socket envelope.
pipe-kit.detail: Weld or trim hidden tee and cross intersections. All ports sit at 0.36 m centre height.

queue-rail.title: Queue rail
queue-rail.assembly_note: One wide rounded rail on three chunky stanchions. Use the footprint as a decorative boundary.

floor-grate.title: Floor grate
floor-grate.assembly_note: Flush service opening with six wide slats. Set the model origin at floor level.
floor-grate.detail: 0.575 m total height includes the recessed sleeve. Visible height above the floor is 0.095 m.

lamp-post.title: Lamp post
lamp-post.assembly_note: One stout post and a wide capped lantern. Use a shared lens material for the apparent light.

steam-vent.title: Steam vent
steam-vent.assembly_note: Low, broad vent with a readable dark aperture. The static mesh ends at the lip.

planter-box.title: Planter box
planter-box.assembly_note: Four broad plant masses in a rounded trough. Use an opaque foliage atlas and keep the plants below 1 m.
planter-box.detail: The clusters can share one plant mesh and atlas.
